name: Sunlu (Zhuhai Sunlu Industrial Co., Ltd.)
summary: Founded July 2013 in Zhuhai, Guangdong, Sunlu is a high-volume Chinese filament producer with three FDM production bases, 20,000+ tons of cumulative shipments and 36 global distribution points. It sells under its own brand, is well known for its S-series filament dryers, and manufactures for several budget retail labels.
